title: List the last names of members who attended the 'Women's Soccer' event and
question: List the last names of members who attended the 'Women's Soccer' event and also incurred expenses in more than one event. Return only the member with the highest total expense amount.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m."XCL_036" AS last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m."XCL_034" = e."XCL_022"
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS ev ON a."XCL_001" = ev."XCL_010"
    WHERE ev."XCL_011" = 'Women''s Soccer'
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT e2."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS e2
    JOIN budget AS b ON e2."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
    JOIN event AS ev2 ON b."XCL_009" = ev2."XCL_010"
    GROUP BY e2."XCL_022"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev2."XCL_010") > 1
)
GROUP BY m."XCL_034"
ORDER BY SUM(e."XCL_020") DESC
LIMIT 1
